scripts.test: tsc --noEmit && npm run -s build && node scripts/browser-check.mjs && tsx src/replay.ts && tsx src/twoworlds.ts && tsx src/grouptest.ts && tsx src/demography.ts 6 20 && tsx src/test.ts 6 5
scripts.build: esbuild src/app.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --minify --outfile=/tmp/lab-bundle.js && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('/tmp/lab-bundle.js','utf8');if(b.includes('</script')||/\\bprocess\\./.test(b))throw new Error('bundle not browser-safe');fs.writeFileSync('index.html',fs.readFileSync('page.html','utf8').replace('__BUNDLE__',()=>b))"
